# horsie_environment (Resource)

A reusable runtime + repos bundle.

**Experimental.** horsie does not consume environments yet — sessions, agent presets and routines do not reference one, and the `provision` steps are inert. The resource exists so the definition can be written down now; expect its consumers to arrive later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "horsie_environment" "ci" {
  name        = "ci"
  description = "Checkout of the main repo on the build fleet"
  vendor      = "fleet"

  repos {
    url     = "https://github.com/blossomstack/horsie"
    git_ref = "main"
  }

  env_var {
    name  = "RUST_LOG"
    value = "info"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Slug used in API paths. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `vendor` (String) Runtime vendor name. Required, and never `local`: environments only target vendor-managed, provisionable runtimes.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What this environment is for. Defaults to empty.
- `env_var` (Block List) Plain-text, non-sensitive environment variables for the runtime. Secrets are a separate future concept — do not put one here, it is stored and returned in clear. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--env_var))
- `provision` (Block List) Setup steps the runtime executes before its message loop. Inert today. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--provision))
- `repos` (Block List) Repositories cloned into the runtime workspace at provision time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repos))

<a id="nestedblock--env_var"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env_var`

Required:

- `name` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedblock--provision"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provision`

Required:

- `name` (String) Display label, e.g. `checkout horsie`.
- `uses` (String) Step kind, e.g. `git_checkout`.

Optional:

- `with` (Block List) Key/value parameters, interpreted per `uses`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--provision--with))

<a id="nestedblock--provision--with"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provision.with`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)



<a id="nestedblock--repos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repos`

Required:

- `url` (String) HTTPS clone URL.

Optional:

- `dir` (String) Directory under the workspace. Omit for the repo basename.
- `git_ref` (String) Branch, tag or commit. Omit for the default branch.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Resources are addressed by their name/alias, which is the id of record.
terraform import horsie_environment.example ci
```
